h2_sign_upto.grade: A DEFINITION -- NO GRADE IN THE THREE-GRADE VOCABULARY (it is not a terminal)
h2_sign_upto.why: a Prop over `classK` windows and b321`s `poleTerm`, `primeSum`, `archTerm`; it names no zero of zeta and no real part: the salt-check passes

h2_sign_imp_upto.why: the restriction of `h2_sign` to the windows vanishing outside [-L0, L0]; one line

upto_all_imp_h2_sign.why: compact support of a classK window gives a bound r; the finite positivity at r is the sign

h2_sign_iff_forall_upto.why: `h2_sign <-> forall L0, h2_sign_upto L0`: both sides the kernel`s Props, the join proved

forall_upto_iff_rh.why: the join composed with `h2_sign_iff_rh` (Seam.lean:101); its right side is Mathlib`s `RiemannHypothesis`

rowgen.name: SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.h2_sign_upto
rowgen.doc: **(R169)(3)'s finite positivity, in the kernel's vocabulary:** `h2_sign`'s sign on the `classK` windows that vanish outside `[-L₀, L₀]`.
rowgen.body1: ∀ k : ℝ → ℂ, classK k → (∀ u : ℝ, L₀ < |u| → k u = 0) → 0 ≤ poleTerm k - primeSum k + archTerm k

rowgen.name: SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.h2_sign_imp_upto
rowgen.doc: `h2_sign` gives the finite positivity at every `L₀`.
rowgen.body1: fun h k hk _ => h k hk

rowgen.name: SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.upto_all_imp_h2_sign
rowgen.doc: Every `classK` window has compact support, so it vanishes outside some `[-r, r]`: the finite positivity at every `L₀` is `h2_sign`.

rowgen.name: SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.h2_sign_iff_forall_upto
rowgen.doc: **The join:** `h2_sign` is the finite positivity at every support bound.
rowgen.body1: ⟨fun h L₀ => h2_sign_imp_upto L₀ h, upto_all_imp_h2_sign⟩

rowgen.name: SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.forall_upto_iff_rh
rowgen.doc: **The join, to Mathlib:** the finite positivity at every support bound is Mathlib's `RiemannHypothesis`, through `h2_sign_iff_rh` (Seam.lean:101)
